concerns.text: The plan states that FR‑018 cannot be satisfied because the DNS‑Challenge dataset lacks a verified source, and therefore a proxy subset from Voices‑in‑the‑Wild‑2M will be used instead. FR‑018 explicitly requires validation of synthetic distortions against a ≥ 50‑clip subset of the DNS‑Challenge dataset. Since the DNS‑Challenge dataset is not a verified dataset, this functional requirement is unmet, making the approach unable to fulfill a core requirement of the specification.
